description: Pinned external reference assets for the Ancestry-Aware Variant Explorer (HACKATHON_PROJECT_PLAN.md Step 2). All sources are public. The setup command downloads these and verifies checksums WITHOUT transmitting any sample data. Checksums are filled in on first successful download and then enforced on subsequent runs.
coordinate_convention_note: Source FASTA and 1000 Genomes VCFs are 1-based. Internal records use 0-based half-open; conversion happens in adapters (Step 1) and is preserved through harmonization.

toolchain.note: Pinned at Step 2 development time. Record the actual local versions in the harmonization report for each run.

reference_fasta.role: GRCh37 primary assembly reference genome (autosomes + X/Y/MT, no alt/decoy). Used by the FULL pipeline; it is the exact reference the 1000G Phase 3 panel was aligned to, so REF-allele checks are coherent.
reference_fasta.license: 1000 Genomes Project data use: open/unrestricted public data. Verify current terms at https://www.internationalgenome.org/data

reference_fasta_slice.role: Single-chromosome GRCh37 FASTA for the small-real-slice validation path (approach B). Laptop-friendly real reference data.
reference_fasta_slice.coherence_note: Ensembl GRCh37 chr22 is used for the slice. For positions validated in the slice window we additionally confirm the panel REF matches this FASTA; mismatches are reported, not silently flipped. The full pipeline uses human_g1k_v37 end to end.
reference_fasta_slice.license: Ensembl: no restrictions on use; verify current terms at https://www.ensembl.org/info/about/legal/

phased_panel.role: Phased reference panel for statistical phasing (consumed in Step 3) and REF/ALT + allele-frequency context.
phased_panel.note: GRCh37 low-coverage Phase 3 call set. Distinct from the GRCh38 high-coverage NYGC 3202 release. Per-chromosome files; the slice validation downloads a single chromosome.
phased_panel.license: 1000 Genomes Project open data. Verify current terms.

variant_sites.role: Variant catalog for REF/ALT resolution and rsID cross-check. Derived from the phased panel sites when a standalone sites file is not pinned.
variant_sites.note: For the slice path, sites are taken from the single-chromosome panel VCF. A standalone dbSNP GRCh37 sites file may be pinned later if needed.

genetic_map.role: Recombination map for the phasing tool (consumed in Step 3). Pinned now for provenance.
genetic_map.note: Exact source pinned when Step 3 selects the phasing tool (Beagle/SHAPEIT bundle its own compatible map). Placeholder recorded here to keep the manifest complete.

gene_annotation.role: Gene models for gene-region views (consumed in Step 6). Pinned now for provenance.
gene_annotation.note: GENCODE release 19 is the canonical GRCh37 annotation.
gene_annotation.license: GENCODE/Ensembl: freely available; verify current terms at https://www.gencodegenes.org
